standard: OpenAPI Specification 3.1.1, Appendix C.2 and Appendix E.5
policy: RFC6570 structural comma delimiters are percent-encoded when allowReserved is false. Literal square brackets, vertical bars, and spaces used by deepObject, pipeDelimited, and spaceDelimited MUST be percent-encoded in a URI.
notes: These decisions change only ENCODING_REVIEW rows. All inputs and captured requests remain unchanged.
